sections.Profile:
"Cleopatra," released by Marvel Manufacturing Company in May 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine with an ancient Egyptian theme. The playfield features two flippers, 12 passive bumpers, and three kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Marvel Manufacturing Company
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Historical Figure, Single Player, Wood Rail, Original Theme, History
